description: DYNAMIC LENGTH elementary item — a variable-length, minimum-length-zero PIC X/N string (§2023:8.5.1.10 / §2023:13.18.19), ISO 2014+; below 2014 the DYNAMIC LENGTH clause is COBOL0900. LIVE (P12 wave 2): the item is a native string (no byte substrate); a receiving MOVE truncates to the LIMIT with no padding (CobolDynString.Store). The 2023 SET [SIZE OF] length enhancement (VCR row 60) is deferred to P13.
citation: ISO §2023:8.5.1.10 / §2023:13.18.19 — variable-length min-0 string; §2023:13.16.3 SR18 permitted co-clauses; §2023:13.18.19.3 SR1 PICTURE one N or X

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. DL.
